title: Refactor Pantheon Ops business menu information architecture (bizscope, service catalog, ArgoCD de-brand)
goal: Restructure the Pantheon Ops business navigation from two thin single pages into two M-directories with six C sub-menus (bizscope: scope list/host bindings/environments with a new biz_business_environment CRUD entity; service catalog: applications/services/instances reusing existing list APIs), retire the two old menu paths through the overlay, and reduce the ArgoCD menu to display-only 'Application Delivery' wording without changing any internal identifier; keep seed, registry, i18n, smoke and overlay contracts green in the same delivery.

in: bizscope module: replace the single C menu with an M parent plus three C menus (scope list, host bindings, environment management); existing BizScope CRUD migrates under /business/bizscope/scopes

New BusinessEnvironment entity: biz_business_environment table (child of business scope, composite unique on business_scope_id+code, soft delete), AutoMigrate, four CRUD endpoints under /business/bizscope/environments, service tests and seed tests
Host bindings page reuses the existing CMDB host list API with its businessScopeId filter; no new backend endpoint

Service catalog: replace the three-tab ServiceCatalog monolith with an M parent plus three C menus under /business/service-catalog/{applications,services,instances}; all three pages reuse the existing application/service/instance list APIs and the existing business:service:list permission

Retire /business/business-scope[/:id], /business/service and component business/service/ServiceCatalog via retired_modules_overlay.go (MenuPaths/ComponentKeys cleanup before module seeding); delete ServiceCatalog.tsx after the three-way split
ArgoCD de-branding: i18n display values only, zh '应用发布' / en 'Application Delivery', including permission wording; paths, permission keys, component directory, route names and API routes are retained

Frontend/backend component registry parity, business-overlay.json sync, bilingual i18n seed/resource parity, smoke spec rewrite plus a new bizscope smoke suite, smoke README and package.json script registration
L2 governance in pantheon-ops: this task packet, plan.md and the evidence/review delivery under .harness
out: CI capabilities; the current CD/GitOps behavior stays as-is and the CI half remains unbuilt
Renaming cicd paths, permission keys, component directories, API routes, constants or type identifiers
Changing the existing BizScope.Environment enum field or the service-instance free-text environment field
The legacy e2e-tests manual suite except text-only fixes where a changed display string breaks an assertion
Renaming BUSINESS_ARGOCD_MODULE_DESIGN.md and other design documents
Any new dependency, gate weakening, dismissal or suppression; production data and credentials

implementationNotes: Hard Stop: all paths under backend/ and frontend/ are pantheon-ops repo-relative and are implemented exclusively by the Codex executor; .harness/ and docs/harness/ paths are also pantheon-ops repo-relative and owned by the Claude coordinator.

Seed upsert matches by path and overwrites every field including type/component/parent_id, so same-path M/C conversions leave no orphan; only the two retired paths need overlay cleanup, which runs before module seeding.

The three service-catalog C pages reuse business:service:list as pagePermission; no new service permission keys are introduced. The bizscope host-binding and environment pages introduce six new permission keys total.
The soft-deleted environment row still occupies the (business_scope_id, code) unique index, matching the existing BizScope convention; document the limit in a code comment.

ServiceCatalog.tsx is a deletion, not a modification: its application/service/instance logic is split three ways before the file is removed, keeping each replacement below the monolith's cognitive complexity.

Five suggested reviewable commits: (1) environment entity backend plus tests, (2) seed restructure plus retirement plus seed tests, (3) frontend pages/modules/registries, (4) smoke and contract/overlay sync, (5) bilingual i18n de-branding.

At execution start flip status to in-progress, create the evidence directory, change linkage.reviewFile from 'none' to the canonical review path, and add verificationPlan.visualEvidence with the 1440px/390px viewports and six routes so check:harness-visual tracks delivery.

2026-11-14 user authorized planned execution. Formal versioned migration 000038 replaces obsolete AutoMigrate-only assumption; the host-binding page requires its page key and an independently granted CMDB read key because official provider registration forbids cross-domain route grants.
